prompt_inputs.goal: Carbohydrate loading for marathon race tomorrow with high caloric intake and strategic pre-race meal timing

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full day with 3+ meals and snacks totaling 3000+ calories
Carbohydrates comprise 60-70% of total calories to support endurance performance
Includes specific timing for pre-race meal (light, easily digestible) 2-3 hours before race start
All meals and portions are realistic and achievable for a single person in one day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a professional endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate loading the day before competition, including specific timing for pre-race meals
